goal: Validate Phoebus truth map and local recall timeout
body: Dave asked Kaedra about Phoebus. Kaedra's first answer invented unsupported architecture details. Verified live facts: Kaedra runs through local Ollama on Phoebus; shard federation reports Phoebus fanout OK; latest recall had Phoebus local lane timeout at the 25s budget; WhoArt separately returned invalid node token 401. Please verify Phoebus physical-node identity, current services/vaults, recent milestones, and diagnose the local recall timeout. Do not introduce architecture names or status percentages without shard or runtime evidence. Done when a provenance-backed Phoebus status packet is relayed up.

relay.note: phoebus/claude-app/562f7a8e — this is my own box and I have direct evidence. Also: Kaedra's invented architecture details are a MEASURED defect, not a one-off; baseline at 22436@db3 caught her fabricating shard contents, and her served persona is instructed to be "absolute and frictionless". Delivering a provenance-backed status packet with the local-recall-timeout diagnosis.
